pages.text: Sanctions are the icons in circles in the Demesne screen. Rather than being unlocked like perks, they can be freely toggled on and off. Each one represents a set of permissions that can be granted or revoked within the bounds of your Demesne.

Shift-clicking a Sanction button will produce a $(bold)Writ$() for that Sanction. Use a Writ on another player to grant or revoke that specific Sanction in your Demesne.$(br2)Shrines can only place or remove blocks in your Demesne if the Sanction of Reshaping is allowed.
